quest.title: A Brief History of Rocks
quest.description: One wonders if there are any clues to be found for entering the Great Volcano of Tollan amidst these crumbling ruins...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *sigh* These rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Every day, they come crashing down... This eruption cycle really is something else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi! Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* It's rare for people to venture out this way. What can I help you with? *cough* ... Is that a little Tepetlisaurus?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Are you from the Children of Echoes? I didn't realize they were so interested in fashion these days *cough* ... I've never seen such clothes — not to mention a flying pet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Who are you calling a pet!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Paimon's a guide and a companion. Paimon's no one's pet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And for your information, we're not from the Children of Echoes either!

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: In that case, this little Tepetlisaurus...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's a great friend we met during our travels!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #My name's Paimon, this is {NICKNAME}, and this little fellow is {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're... adventurers, and we're looking for a way to get into the volcano.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Ah. So, you want help getting inside...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: The way up there... *cough* I'm not trying to scare you away, but you should know the Great Volcano of Tollan isn't an easy place to get into... *cough*

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: If you're not careful, the air itself can burn your windpipe... *cough* If that happens, the effects will plague you for the rest of your life.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: S—So s—scary... Are you sure the air is really that hot? Have you ever seen it happen to anyone?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* *cough*

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Evidently...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're looking at someone it's happened to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, ah... Paimon didn't know...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: It's fine... *cough* There was no way for you to know. Call me Mposo. I tried to go into the volcano once and... well, *cough* I found it to be a dangerous place, alright.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: But I imagine your desire to visit may have something to do with your little companion here...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha, it looks like he doesn't even know it yet... There are always saurians like this, who, before reaching adulthood, are drawn to the Sacred Mountain — it's like they've heard the volcano's call.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: However, most of them don't bring companions. It should go without saying that other saurians don't want to accompany them — after all, they never come back... *cough*

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: #This is a dangerous road you tread, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, don't worry about us! We laugh in the face of danger. Isn't that right, {NICKNAME}!?

choices.text: I won't get out of bed for anything less than the possibility of death!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha... *cough* Such a brave little fellow!

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: A saurian with a mark on its head... There was a little Tatankasaurus in the tribe like this a good many years ago. It would rarely interact with tribespeople, or even other Tatankasaurs.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* Maybe lonely souls are easily drawn together — back then, it and I got along quite well.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: But in the end, it, too, was drawn to the volcano... *cough* It came to see me one last time before it left. Perhaps it was hoping I would accompany it.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: But... I didn't go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, why didn't you?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: I don't know... Maybe I was scared... Maybe I didn't realize how important a friend could be...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Later, when they organized an exploration team, I volunteered to join... Was it guilt? Or did I want to prove myself to a friend I wasn't sure was still there...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: In the end, I never found him. Instead, I... *cough*

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: I haven't been able to stop coughing since then. Pretty hopeless, aren't I... *cough* Can't even clear up these rocks that keep falling on the ruins.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: The volcano's a dangerous place and its internal structure is complex. Not to mention... the environment there is unique, and parts of it have been corroded by the Abyss... Are you sure you want to go, even so?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're sure.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* ...Now that's an admirable look.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: We're currently in the middle of an eruption cycle. Hehe, the worse the Ley Lines get, the more frequently the volcano erupts. Ironically, this is the best time to try and get inside.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* I can tell you how to get in, but before I do, I'd like to see a... show of strength, let's say... *cough*

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Clear away the pumice the volcanic activity has left strewn on the ruins!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's not a "show of strength"! That's us helping you complete your chores!

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha... *cough* When you ask someone for help, it's always nice to show them kindness in return... Besides, as we say here in the Collective of Plenty:

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: "If you can't move a rock, how do you expect to move a volcano?"

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* ...Just show me how strong you are, please...

choices.text: That's right, Paimon. We stand tall, even 'neath a crumbling wall!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon doesn't understand what you said, but she knows it doesn't sound good!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawwr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmph, don't you dare start copying {M#him}{F#her}!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you still looking so pleased about!? Take back that part about Paimon being a pet, right now!

talks.objective: Talk to the person who guards this place

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* ...Hey, the wall of light that was here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... It seems like the golden seal opened after those golden patterns flew over here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't break it... did we?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Roar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sh—Should we be getting ready to run?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* There's no need for that. *sigh* I've spent years researching that thing — never would've thought you'd get it open like that.

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: It's just a shame... *cough* Everything behind the light wall has been buried under rocks. For all we know, this may have once been an important route into a "satellite city."

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Yes, one of the cities built around the main city to protect it...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: They say it was once an ancient dragon outpost, destroyed during the war between Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon, and the dragons...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: The members of the Saurian Relics Association all agree that these ruins were built as a satellite city to protect the main dragon city located at the center of the volcano...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The d—dragons built a city... inside a volcano!?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrooh...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, everything we saw before...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* Alright, since you helped me clear up those rocks, I'll tell you how to get inside.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: During an eruption, the volcano will eject a vast amount of Phlogiston and other things... Most of which fall on the surrounding area.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: However, some of the things it spits out float — due to the Phlogiston — remaining in the air and accumulating to form the "Skyfire{RUBY#[D]Nahuatzin's Springboard} Circlet"...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: I'm talking about those fragmented structures that surround the volcano... You'll have to climb up above the mountain and look for your opportunity to jump inside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: J—Jump... inside?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Yes, you can only get in by passing through the crater... It's filled with Phlogiston, so you'll have to be careful...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: It was tribespeople from the Flower-Feather Clan who guided us through... Perhaps you can make similar arrangements. But whatever you do, do not breathe anything in...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Otherwise... *cough*

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So that's how we do it...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrwar? Mrrroo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's an earthquake... Wait, no — the volcano's erupting!

choices.text: Isn't this place called the "excavation site"?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha... *cough* Sure, but that wasn't always its name. That's just what the tribespeople call it these days...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: A truly charitable deed — it would have taken all I had and then some to cough my way through clearing them out.

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* ...Hey, the wall of light here...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Did you open it?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha, there's no need to be nervous *cough* ... The truth is, I'm a guard on patrol. The name's Mposo...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Sometimes, I also like to study the ruins *cough* ... I'm ashamed to say, I've been trying to open this thing for a long time...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* ...I didn't expect someone to just... show up and settle the matter on my behalf...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: This place hasn't seen travelers from another tribe in quite some time. So, tell me, are you here to investigate the volcano?

dialogues.text: Yeah, but first, we need to find a way to get to the Skyfire Circlet, right?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* Been speaking to Dutse then, have you? "Idle Old Man Mposo" is standing before your eyes, but you can call me Mposo, thank you very much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? But, they called you... "Old Man" Mposo...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Aye, they would. Dutse and most of the other children in the tribe have taken to calling me "Old Man."

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* It's hard to explain to an outsider... My great-grandfather was the youngest child of his generation, as was my grandfather, and then my father before me...

response.speaker: Mposo

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Do you know how to get in there?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, of course!

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* I'm Mposo, I tried to go into the volcano once and... well, *cough* it truly is a dangerous place.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so you're "Idle Old Man Mposo"?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* Been speaking to Dutse then, have you? Indeed, I am "Idle Old Man Mposo," in the flesh! But do call me Mposo, thank you very much.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Wait. Why "Old Man" Mposo...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Aye, aye. Dutse and most of the other children in the tribe have taken to calling me that.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* It's hard to explain to an outsider... My great-grandfather was the youngest child of his generation, as was my grandfather, and then my father before me...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* I might not look it, but I'm a couple of generations above them in the pecking order, so they've taken to calling me "Old Man"... So, Dutse told you about me, and now you want help getting inside the volcano?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: You must be exceptionally strong if you wish to venture inside... *cough* I wonder, then... Could you help me with something?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *sigh* Earlier adventures have left me somewhat feeble. You see these rocks the volcanic activity has left strewn on the ruins?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* I'm unable to clear them away. I don't suppose you could help me remove them, could you? Hehe, you can keep anything interesting you find...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? We can just take 'em and go?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Think of it as a reward for your hard work *cough* ... Besides, if you do stumble across something, it may well be of more use to you than to me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #In that case... {NICKNAME}!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Okay!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, I'll leave it to you then!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you still looking so pleased about!? Take back that part about Paimon being a pet, right now!

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* The volcano gets more active whenever it enters a new eruption cycle and these falling rocks do massive damage to the ruins...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: How about it? Will you *cough* ...help me clear them out?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Those rocks have finally been cleared away *cough* ... Did you do all this?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: A truly charitable deed — it would have taken all I had and then some to cough my way through clearing them out.

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* ...Hey, the wall of light here...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Did you open it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Seems like the seal opened after those golden patterns flew over here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We didn't break it... did we?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Grawr...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha, there's no need to be nervous *cough* ... The truth is, I'm a guard on patrol. The name's Mposo...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Sometimes, I also like to study the ruins *cough* ... I'm ashamed to say, I've been trying to open this thing for a long time...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* ...I didn't expect someone to just... show up and settle the matter on my behalf...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Huh, you must be "Idle Old Man Mposo"...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh ho, now there's a familiar sounding title! You must have been talking to Duniya and Dutse...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Hmph, Duniya's a good kid... I can only assume it was Dutse who told you that one...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: This place hasn't seen travelers from another tribe in quite some time. So, tell me, are you here to investigate the volcano?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You introduce yourselves to Mposo and explain that you wish to visit the volcano.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Ah, adventurers who wish to get into that mountain... *cough* I tried to go in there once and... well, *cough* it's a truly dangerous place.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: But I imagine your desire may have something to do with your little companion here...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Haha, it looks like he doesn't even know it yet... There are always saurians like this, who, before reaching adulthood, are drawn to the Sacred Mountain — it's like they've heard the volcano's call.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: However, most of them don't bring companions. It should go without saying that other saurians don't want to accompany them — after all, they never come back... *cough*

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: A saurian with a mark on its head... There was a little Tatankasaurus in the tribe like this a good many years ago. It would rarely interact with tribespeople, or even other Tatankasaurs.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* Maybe lonely souls are easily drawn together — back then, it and I got along quite well.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: But in the end, it, too, was drawn to the volcano... *cough* It came to see me one last time before it left. Perhaps it was hoping I would accompany it.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: But... I didn't go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, why didn't you?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: I don't know... Maybe I was scared... Maybe I didn't realize how important a friend could be...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Later, when they organized an exploration team, I volunteered to join... Was it guilt? Or did I want to prove myself to a friend I wasn't sure was still there...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: In the end, I never found him. Instead, I... *cough*

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: I haven't been able to stop coughing since then. Pretty hopeless, aren't I... *cough* Can't even clear up these rocks that keep falling on the ruins.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roar...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: So, yeah. The volcano's a dangerous place. Do you want to go even so?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We're sure.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* ...Now that's an admirable look.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: We're currently in the middle of an eruption cycle. *cough* The worse the Ley Lines get, the more frequently the volcano erupts. But ironically, this is the best time to try and get inside.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: *cough* Alright, since you helped me clear up those rocks, I'll tell you how to get in.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: During an eruption, the volcano will eject a vast amount of Phlogiston and other things... Most of which fall on the surrounding area.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: However, some of the things it spits out float — due to the Phlogiston — remaining in the air and accumulating to form the "Skyfire{RUBY#[D]Nahuatzin's Springboard} Circlet"...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: I'm talking about those fragmented structures that surround the volcano... You'll have to climb up above the mountain and look for your opportunity to jump inside.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: J—Jump... inside?

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Yes, you can only get in by passing through the crater... It's filled with Phlogiston, so you'll have to be careful...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: It was tribespeople from the Flower-Feather Clan who guided us through... Perhaps you can make similar arrangements. But whatever you do, do not breathe anything in...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Otherwise... *cough*

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.text: Paimon sees...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rrrwar? Mrrroo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's an earthquake... Wait, no — the volcano's erupting!

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *sigh* These rocks...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Every day, they come crashing down... This eruption cycle really is something else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hi! Hello!

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* It's rare for people to venture out this way. What can I help you with? *cough* ... Is that a little Tepetlisaurus?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: Are you from the Children of Echoes? I didn't realize they were so interested in fashion these days *cough* ... I've never seen such clothes — not to mention a flying pet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Who are you calling a pet!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Exactly! Paimon's a guide and a companion. Paimon's no one's pet!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And for your information, we're not from the Children of Echoes either!

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: In that case, this little Tepetlisaurus...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Ehrr?

response.text: He's a great friend we met during our travels!

dialogues.text: Sh—Should we be getting ready to run?

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: *cough* There's no need for that. *sigh* I spent years researching that wall of light, but I could never find a way to open it...

dialogues.speaker: Mposo
dialogues.text: It's just a shame... *cough* Everything behind it has been buried under rocks. For all we know, this was once an important route into the satellite city.

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Yes, one of the cities built around the main city to protect it...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: They say it was once an ancient dragon outpost, destroyed during the war between Xbalanque, the first Pyro Archon, and the dragons...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: The members of the Saurian Relics Association all agree that these ruins were built as a satellite city to protect the main dragon city located at the center of the volcano...

response.speaker: Mposo
response.text: Alright, just like I said before *cough* ...all this stuff is yours.

response.text: Thank you *cough* ... for helping to clear away those rocks.
